target.title: feat(chat-ui): syntax-highlighted code blocks and native tables in chat markdown
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Assistant messages in the shared chat UI rendered fenced code without syntax highlighting and GFM tables as raw pipe characters, because the whole message went through a single `AttributedString(markdown:)` → `Text` pass that supports neither.

Part of #100195

## Why This Change Was Made

Instead of swapping in a heavy markdown UI dependency, the message is now segmented before rendering (`ChatMarkdownBlockSegmenter`): prose keeps the existing AttributedString pipeline, completed fenced code renders through a lightweight per-language tokenizer (keywords/strings/comments/numbers for swift, kotlin, typescript/javascript, python, bash, json — unknown languages pass through unstyled), and valid GFM tables (header + delimiter row, alignment-aware, escaped-pipe handling) render as a native SwiftUI `Grid`. Anything ambiguous falls back to prose unchanged. The streaming path stays cheap: a fence or table still open at the stream tail renders as plain text, and completed blocks are memoized in a bounded content-keyed highlight cache so deltas never re-tokenize finished work. No new dependency was added: the evaluated highlighting package is dormant upstream and only covers Swift grammar. The old fence/table tracking inside the soft-break preprocessor became dead and was deleted.

## User Impact

Assistant replies show syntax-highlighted code blocks (branded mono typography, language label, horizontal scrolling, light/dark-adaptive colors) and real tables instead of raw `|` runs, on both platforms consuming the shared chat UI (iOS and macOS). Streaming responsiveness is unchanged.

## Evidence

- `apps/shared/OpenClawKit`: `swift build` green; `swift test --filter "ChatMarkdownBlockSegmenterTests|ChatCodeHighlighterTests|ChatMarkdownDisplayPreprocessorTests"` → 43/43 pass (fence info strings, nested ```/~~~, indent dedent, 4-space non-fence, unclosed-fence streaming fallback, trailing-table streaming fallback, alignments, escaped pipes, row pad/truncate, count-mismatch prose fallback).
- `apps/macos`: `swift build` green (shared package consumer).
- Highlight smoke tests assert token classification and byte-exact source preservation.
- Codex autoreview on the commit: one P1 finding, rejected as a false positive — it claimed `Double` components can't be passed to `CGFloat` color initializers, but SE-0307 implicit conversion applies and both platform builds compile the file as-is.

Known gap: rendering verified by compile + unit tests; no simulator screenshot pass yet (dark/light palettes use the same dynamic-provider pattern as `OpenClawChatTheme`).
